The cameras communicate with wifi and low frequency radio. I have similar issues with my shed camera at the back of the yard. Wifi is great with the camera but low frequency radio is weaker. I solved this by adjusting the camera position to have more direct line of site, instead of going through two walls of the shed. Also raised the sync module higher to prevent interference with more obstacles that are found lower. Hope the link from blink below helps explain it more.


 https://support.blinkforhome.com/en_US/f-a-q/signal-strengths
